resources.string: For the app blocking feature to work, you need to grant \'Usage Data Access\'. This helps the app know when an unauthorized app is opened.

The Auto Emergency Call (SOS) feature uses the Accessibility Service ONLY to detect if the phone is being used. It monitors touch interactions to update a local 'last active' timestamp. This is essential for identifying inactivity and triggering rescue calls.

🛡️ PRIVACY ASSURANCE:
• NO collection of personal data.
• NO reading of screen content or text.
• NO sharing of activity data outside this device.
• NO changes to system settings.
This service is purely for user safety and only processes timestamps locally.
DOES NOT read or collect screen content, record typed text, or interfere with personal settings
Detects touch interactions to identify inactivity for Auto SOS calls.

This service is used exclusively by the Auto Emergency Call (SOS) feature to monitor whether the phone is being actively used. It listens only for touch interaction events to update a \"last active\" timestamp on the device. This allows the app to detect abnormal inactivity. The service DOES NOT read screen content, DOES NOT collect text, DOES NOT track other apps, DOES NOT perform gestures, and DOES NOT share any data outside the device.
This feature helps protect users by only allowing selected apps to run. Other apps will be blocked to avoid unintended issues.
To ensure safety, the app will automatically call the quick contact list if no user interaction is detected on the phone.
automatically call the quick contact list
This feature helps protect users by automatically blocking calls from unknown numbers not in the contacts, avoiding being bothered by ads or scams.
